description: This file contains the implementation of a wrapper and client classes for interfacing with OpenAI's API, including methods for chat completions, embeddings, image generation, audio speech, and file management. It defines configuration classes, response iterators, and helper functions to facilitate synchronous and asynchronous interactions with OpenAI services within a larger language model framework.
